high_level_description: This image depicts a cozy and well-arranged living room with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The room features wooden furniture, including a sofa set and a coffee table, which are made of polished wood with a rich, warm tone. The sofa set consists of a three-seater sofa and two armchairs, all upholstered in light beige fabric, complemented by colorful patterned cushions in shades of orange, yellow, and brown. The coffee table is rectangular and has a simple design, matching the style of the sofa set.
